title: CD velocity magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: Must state or derive v_CD = 5(1-k) m/s using momentum conservation for blocks.

title: CD velocity direction
description: Essential Criteria: Must correctly identify direction as rightward (positive) for 0<k<0.5.

title: AB velocity magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: Must state or derive v_AB = (10-20k)/3 m/s using momentum conservation for skateboards.

title: AB velocity direction
description: Important Criteria: Must correctly identify direction as rightward (positive) for 0<k<0.5.

title: Relative displacement calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Must compute final displacement of 1.875 m using work-energy or relative motion with friction.

title: Momentum conservation setup
description: Important Criteria: Must correctly apply momentum conservation separately for block collision and skateboard collision.

title: Common velocity determination
description: Important Criteria: Must find common velocity v_all = 1 m/s when block and skateboard reach relative rest.

title: Sign error in velocities
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize incorrect sign assignment for leftward velocities (negative sign for kv₀ terms).

title: Friction force calculation
description: Important Criteria: Must correctly compute friction force as μmg = 1 N for work-energy or acceleration equations.

title: Mass confusion
description: Pitfall Criteria: Penalize using wrong masses (e.g., confusing skateboard and block masses in momentum equations).
